historical_evidence.event_definition: Next-year calorie availability fell by at least 15 percent and at least 5 kcal/person/day, where current availability was at least 5 kcal/person/day.

historical_country_rank.name: Historical burden rank
historical_country_rank.primary_measure: Wilson lower bound for the full-period event rate
historical_country_rank.reason: Uses the observed shortage rate while accounting for unequal eligible observation denominators.
historical_country_rank.important_limitation: Repeated country-commodity-year observations are not fully independent; Wilson bounds are used as conservative ranking aids, not formal causal or survey confidence intervals.

recent_country_rank.name: Recent burden rank
recent_country_rank.primary_measure: Wilson lower bound for the recent event rate

forward_country_ranks.portfolio_rank: Average predicted 2024 probability across evidence-qualified scored commodities
forward_country_ranks.warning_share: Formal warnings divided by evidence-qualified scored commodities
forward_country_ranks.important_interpretation: Forward ranks are model-generated screening priorities, not observed events or national food-insecurity probabilities.

combined_rank.reason: Combining observed historical events, recent events and model probabilities would require subjective weights and could conceal important commodity-specific signals.

reporting_requirement: Every country report must present denominators, historical rates, recent evidence, commodity breadth, average forward risk, peak forward risk and evidence limitations separately.
